    replace h := congrArg (-a + ·) h

    intro v
    simp [v] at h

  simpa only [LinearOrderedAddCommGroupWithTop.add_neg_cancel _ h, add_zero] using h2

  simpa [add_comm] using injective_add_left_of_ne_top b h
